sources.title: UNBC Statement of Financial Information 2024/25: employee remuneration
sources.scopeDescription: Named employees with remuneration over $75,000; board payments and aggregate rows excluded

validation.independentMethod: pdftotext layout rows compared cell-for-cell to pdfplumber character-coordinate extraction
validation.visualReview: Verified the first employee page, long name/position boundaries, final employee rows, all printed subtotals and the remuneration definition. No row values were changed.

notes: The complete named employee schedule on printed pages 29-35 is imported with positions and original cents. Board payments, below-threshold aggregates and grand totals are not employee rows.

Displayed employee remuneration totals $55,345,679.32, one cent above the printed $55,345,679.31 subtotal. Independent extraction agrees with every displayed monetary cell. The report does not explain the residual; published row values are preserved without adjustment.
Disclosed expenses sum exactly to the printed named subtotal of $2,588,416.01. The 99 dash expense cells are retained as missing rather than assumed zero.

The source excludes employer payments for non-taxable benefits, CPP, EI and WCB, and excludes payments under severance agreements; accounting-basis differences also affect comparisons with financial-statement salary and benefit totals.
